tiles.name: 灰褐色の岩
tiles.detail: Uniform field of gray-brown weathered rock with a distributed network of varied small cracks, shallow pits, tiny pale lichen speckles. No single dominant fissure, no focal rock, no borders.
tiles.prompt: Edit only the provided original gray-brown rock tile for VEILBOUND HUNTERS. Preserve the existing pattern scale, stone colors, scattered lichen, overall even illumination, full-surface layout and lack of a focal object. Make recesses modestly darker and chipped rough raised edges modestly lighter, without any top-to-bottom or side lighting gradient. tiles.initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production rock color texture for original game VEILBOUND HUNTERS. Create one EXACTLY 1024 by 1024 pixel square texture intended to repeat seamlessly left/right AND top/bottom, one tile represents 3 meters of rock. Full image is surface material, not a rock object, not a landscape, no transparency.
Reference 1 is the approved palette and world only. Reference 2 is the prior failed too-flat texture: retain its broad palette but explicitly increase local crevice detail and contrast, do not imitate its clay-like smoothness.
Uniform field of gray-brown weathered rock with a distributed network of varied small cracks, shallow pits, tiny pale lichen speckles. No single dominant fissure, no focal rock, no borders.
Front-on orthographic flat material capture, near-photographic detailed weathered natural rock created originally. Diffuse overcast nondirectional illumination, no directional highlights or shadows and no broad lighting gradient. Macro brightness is even across all four edges. Keep visible material light #8B8D82, darker stone #6E7268; tiny deep crevices #3E413A; edge planes modestly pale. Target perceptual luminance standard deviation around 28 on a 0-255 scale (required20-35), abundant dark small cavities distributed everywhere and brighter rough ledges. Strong enough fine contrast for game surfaces, no dramatic sunlight. All opposite edges must wrap continuously with matching small-scale structures, no border or vignette. No large unique feature, text, marks, symbols, frame, watermark, people, animals, mountains, ground, sky, fog, snow, ocean or lava. No specular flash or glowing crystal, no artistic sketch outlines.
tiles.refinement_note: Initial luma standard deviation 19.8054 was below minimum20; refined version selected after measurement.

tiles.detail: Subtle horizontal thin sedimentary layers with irregular 5 to 20 centimeter beds at a 3 meter tile scale, many narrow layers crossing the width. Rough eroded fine grooves with darker crevices, small chips; no single dominant stripe.
